programme.title: A Floresta Ancestral de Bornéu
programme.desc: Uma viagem ao coração da floresta tropical do Bornéu, subindo rios e colinas para observar a diversidade da vida selvagem, como orangotangos, elefantes, macacos-narigudos, calaus e insetos gigantes. A ilha alberga a mais antiga floresta primária do mundo e um dos ecossistemas mais ricos da Terra.

programme.title: The Daily Show
programme.desc: A conjugação do humor com as notícias, a sátira política e da indústria dos media no geral, blocos de reportagens, diretos e entrevistas a personalidades políticas ou a celebridades de Hollywood.

programme.title: Jornal 2
programme.desc: O mundo em 30 minutos. No Jornal 2 analisamos factos e cruzamos opiniões. A cada dia que passa fazemos leitura do país e do mundo com dados, explicações e interpretações nas mais diversas áreas, como Política, Ciência, Economia e Cultura.

programme.title: Ouro Azul
programme.desc: Em 1986, Alice debate-se entre convicções ambientalistas e expectativas familiares. Quatro décadas depois, Flore investiga o homicídio da mãe, Camille, desvendando o seu envolvimento num assalto ecologista. Flore debate-se entre a verdade do passado da mãe e as pressões familiares que ameaçam o seu noivado. A descoberta da mentira do pai sobre a alegada traição de Camille precede uma reviravolta chocante: o pai é encontrado entre a vida e a morte.

programme.title: O Veto
programme.desc: O veto no Conselho de Segurança da ONU, debatido há 80 anos, é inabalável. Contudo, o seu uso em casos de genocídio e crimes contra a humanidade desrespeita obrigações internacionais, causando enormes perdas de vidas e abalando a ordem multilateral. O documentário de Tim Slade, com especialistas e exemplos como Gaza e Ucrânia, desafia a resignação e investiga soluções viáveis para o impasse no Conselho de Segurança.

programme.title: Deus e Ciência
programme.desc: A confirmação do Big Bang em 1964 estabeleceu a origem do Universo. A astronomia moderna permite traçar a sua evolução e compreender as suas forças. A extraordinária precisão das constantes fundamentais que regem o cosmos, e que possibilitaram o desenvolvimento da vida, levou à formulação de hipóteses como o princípio antrópico, que sugere uma intenção criativa subjacente a este ajuste fino, em vez de mero acaso.

programme.title: The Daily Show
programme.desc: A conjugação do humor com as notícias, a sátira política e da indústria dos media no geral, blocos de reportagens, diretos e entrevistas a personalidades políticas ou a celebridades de Hollywood.

programme.title: Bolseiros
programme.desc: A tensão e a rivalidade atingem o auge quando Jaheim e Leah competem pela glória no infame e moralmente questionável Desafio Carruthers. Toby, Omar e Femi enfrentam um desafio ainda maior quando são interrogados pela polícia depois de Carol descobrir drogas nas dependências da escola. Em pânico, Omar pede ajuda a Rupert, mas será que Rupert estará disposto a ajudar?

programme.title: Refeitório
programme.desc: É herdeiro de um restaurante familiar com história, em Lisboa, que celebrou há pouco tempo 50 anos. Comida tradicional, com foco em pratos de bacalhau, e um serviço de proximidade têm sido os segredos para garantir o sucesso do espaço. Marco Pereira, filho do criador do restaurante e atual proprietário, esta semana, no Refeitório.

programme.title: Nada Será Como Dante
programme.desc: "Os cavalos já estão atrelados", podemos arrancar, desta vez, com as palavras de Anton Tchékhov. Descobrimos "A Vida Vai Engolir-vos". Seguem-se contos que arrepiam sobre diferentes capítulos da História de Portugal. Reduzimos a velocidade para conhecer a antologia de poesia chinesa contemporânea.

programme.title: Janela Indiscreta
programme.desc: O Janela Indiscreta é o seu programa de cinema! Apresenta, em primeira mão, estreias cinematográficas e entrevistas exclusivas aos protagonistas das produções nacionais e internacionais, dando a conhecer curiosidades e histórias de bastidores.

programme.title: Gabinete de Curiosidades
programme.desc: No "Gabinete de Curiosidades" são apresentados vários curiosidades culturais e históricas. De frases intrigantes, à análise de filmes, de pessoas interessantes, a lugares inesperados.

programme.title: Index
programme.desc: Com duas temáticas diferentes por dia, o "Index" é um quizz que coloca o espectador à prova e ainda dá a conhecer várias curiosidades.

programme.title: A Fé dos Homens
programme.desc: Espaço dedicado às diferentes religiões reconhecidas em Portugal e instituídas através de uma Igreja própria.

programme.title: Sociedade Civil
programme.desc: O Sociedade Civil é um programa com História que quer fazer cada vez mais parte do dia-a-dia de todos os portugueses. São questões públicas debatidas por gente distinta, temas particulares apresentados de forma clara. Apresentado pelo jornalista Luís Castro, de segunda a sexta-feira, às 14h00.

programme.title: Molang
programme.desc: Molang é uma série infantil com um olhar afetuoso e bem-humorado sobre a amizade entre um coelho excêntrico, alegre e entusiasta e Piu Piu, um pintainho tímido, discreto e sentimental.

programme.title: Cadetes
programme.desc: Os nossos amigos são cadetes espaciais, exploradores em formação numa academia espacial de uma escola de jogos no planeta WotWot. Nessa academia, os cinco amigos aprendem e brincam juntos, mas cada um tem uma área de interesse especial como arte ou ciência.

programme.title: Kiri e Lou
programme.desc: Numa floresta de papel recortado e com criaturas feitas de argila, Kiri, um pequeno dinossauro mal-humorado com emoções avassaladoras e Lou, uma criatura gentil e atenciosa, podem parecer os melhores amigos mais improváveis.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing Bunny é uma série baseada nos livros infantis do autor e ilustrador Ted Dewan. Celebra as realidades, a aprendizagem e a aventura de ser uma criança do pré-escolar quando a vida está repleta de dramas quotidianos, tanto para as crianças como para os adultos.

programme.title: Jasmine e Jambo
programme.desc: Jasmine e Jambo são loucos por música. Eles vivem em Soundland, uma terra divertida e surreal onde a música e a vida andam de mãos dadas.

programme.title: Pirata & Capitão
programme.desc: Ser pirata e capitão é uma busca sem fim por tesouros, viver grandes aventuras, diversão e espírito de equipa.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.desc: De Tóquio a Nova York, da Austrália a Madagáscar, passando pela Grécia, Mouk e Chavapa encontram habitantes de todo o planeta ... Traz a tua bicicleta e junta-te a estes amigos numa aventura à descoberta do mundo real, moderno e super colorido!

programme.title: A Ovelha Choné
programme.desc: Ovelha Choné? Pois esta ovelha é um pouco excêntrica, como o nome indica! Aventuras cheias de humor na quinta, sob a supervisão do Agricultor e de Bitzer, o cão pastor.

programme.title: Dinoster: Os Heróis Quânticos
programme.desc: Acompanha as aventuras de quatro amigos que aparentam levar uma vida normal, mas viajam em segredo para a Dino Terra para estudar os dinossauros e salvá-los do perigo. É a equipa Dinoster!

programme.title: Minúsculo
programme.desc: Combinando animação e imagens reais, sem diálogo, esta série oferece uma visão pouco frequente da vida diária dos insetos e uma nova maneira de descobrir a natureza. Mergulhamos nos campos verdejantes para observar a vida quotidiana dos insetos sob o prisma distorcido do burlesco e da poesia.

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lemingues
programme.desc: Grizzy, o urso, e a família mais desmiolada de sempre, os Lemingues, estão de volta para novas, atribuladas e divertidas aventuras desta vez numa viagem pelo mundo!

programme.title: Radar XS
programme.desc: Radar XS é um telejornal para crianças dos 8 aos 12 anos onde se pretende incentivar o pensamento crítico e a cidadania consciente. Vamos juntar a política e a cultura, a economia e desporto, a ciência e a literatura infantil, a atualidade nacional e internacional numa linguagem simples e objetiva.

programme.title: Sempre Atrasados
programme.desc: Todas as manhãs, Nuno e Malika saem de casa 30 minutos mais cedo para ir à escola e ainda assim todas as manhãs chegam atrasados! Isto porque todas as manhãs, algo incrível acontece no caminho. Mas mesmo que as suas histórias sejam sempre verdadeiras, a diretora da escola nunca acredita nelas...

programme.title: O Leonel das Moscas
programme.desc: Acompanha as aventuras de Leonel, uma mosca doméstica e filho do meio de muitos irmãos. Lloyd mora com os seus pais, a sua irmãzinha e os seus irmãos larvas dentro de um compostor a que chamam lar.

programme.title: As Aventuras de Ladybug
programme.desc: Marinette e Adrien durante o dia são dois adolescentes normais com uma vida normal, mas há uma coisa sobre eles que ainda ninguém sabe: quando algo ameaça a cidade, Marinette e Adrien transformam-se em Ladybug e Cat Noir!

programme.title: Zoe e Milo
programme.desc: Zoe e Milo são duas crianças de dez anos. Eles não são apenas vizinhos que vivem numa cidade grande, são os melhores amigos. E também são aventureiros: viajam pelo mundo num avião construído e pilotado por Alim, um hamster.

programme.title: Index

programme.title: Esec-tv
programme.desc: Um programa integralmente produzido por profissionais, alunos e estagiários da licenciatura em Comunicação Social, contando com a colaboração de estudantes de outras licenciaturas da ESEC.

programme.title: Preto no Branco
programme.desc: A série "Preto no Branco" revisita a história da RTP desde 1957, mergulhando no seu arquivo para desvendar tesouros esquecidos e a memória de Portugal em preto e branco. Os episódios funcionam como aforismos, mostrando um país alinhado com o regime, mas também a pobreza, a modernização e os primeiros passos da televisão. A pesquisa revela imagens e filmes inéditos, digitalizados para trazer à luz um passado que, visto hoje, parece inverosímil.

programme.title: A Maldição do Açúcar
programme.desc: No alvorecer do século XX, o açúcar impulsionou a expansão americana, enriquecendo magnatas como Havemeyer e barões que dominaram as Caraíbas, explorando terras em Cuba e reprimindo trabalhadores. A concorrência da beterraba europeia e a nacionalização cubana alteraram o cenário. Hoje, a monocultura mecanizada persiste, reinventando-se à custa dos seus operários, levantando a questão da emancipação.

programme.title: Carpe Diem
programme.desc: Justine Petrini, ginasta em preparação para os Jogos Olímpicos, é acusada do roubo da máscara mortuária de Napoleão Bonaparte no Museu Masséna, durante o qual houve uma vítima a registar. Tom, duvidando da culpabilidade de Justine, estabelece uma ligação com a sua filha Zoé. Entretanto, Sigourney investiga Salvatore de Santis, irmão de Anna, uma das últimas pessoas a ter visto a vítima com vida.

Depois de um casamento forçado, Mary X muda-se para o apartamento de Henry, mas acaba por abandoná-lo, a ele e à estranha criatura mutante que chora insistentemente durante a noite.

programme.title: duARTe: Uma Peça de Arte

programme.title: Agenda Zigzaguear
programme.desc: Todas as semanas trazemos propostas de atividades culturais para crianças e famílias de Norte a Sul do país. Sugerimos espetáculos de teatro, música, cinema, exposições, oficinas e muito mais. Uma agenda inteiramente dedicada aos mais pequenos!

programme.title: Faça Chuva Faça Sol
programme.desc: "Faça Chuva Faça Sol" é um programa semanal que explora a agricultura e floresta portuguesas. Focando-se em inovação, sustentabilidade e novos protagonistas, ilustra a fusão de tradição e tecnologia que define o futuro rural. Com reportagens de todo o país, dos Açores à Madeira, aborda projetos e gestões agrícolas relevantes. O seu objetivo é mudar a visão sobre a agricultura nacional, destacando o seu crescimento, valor e papel crucial na economia.

programme.title: Biosfera
programme.desc: A ilha do Porto Santo é candidata a reserva da biosfera da UNESCO, galardão que enfatiza, sobretudo a harmonia da relação entre o Homem e as suas atividades e o meio envolvente.

programme.title: Desliga-te
programme.desc: "Desliga-te" é um programa inovador, apresentado por Rodrigo Castro e com influencers convidados, que transporta jovens do digital para a natureza. Cada episódio, uma lufada de ar fresco, utiliza dinâmicas ao ar livre para criar um espaço seguro e sem filtros. Aqui, os jovens deixam de ser espectadores para debater o futuro, a pressão das redes sociais e os desafios da sua geração, provando que a verdadeira conexão não exige Wi-Fi.

programme.title: Folha de Sala
programme.desc: Uma agenda cultural que destaca espectáculos de teatro, música e outros, não esquecendo o lançamento de livros e discos, o cinema e ainda a realização de outros eventos, como exposições, espectáculos ao ar livre, conferências. Texto e locução de Manuela Silva Reis.

programme.title: Voleibol Feminino: Liga Solverde.pt Feminina - SC Braga x Sporting CP
programme.desc: Está de regresso a principal competição do voleibol feminino português. A Liga Solverde.pt 2026/27 arranca a 11 de outubro de 2026, reunindo 12 equipas numa temporada que se prolonga pela primavera de 2027, com a fase regular e os respetivos play-offs a decidirem o novo campeão nacional. Em competição estarão FC Porto, SC Braga, SL Benfica, Sporting CP, Leixões SC, PV Colégio Efanor, Vitória SC, Clube Kairós, Castêlo da Maia GC, AA São Mamede, CD Fiães e GC Vilacondense.

programme.title: Suor!
programme.desc: Este texto explora o suor, uma função corporal subestimada, mas vital, cuja importância científica para a saúde, dieta e bem-estar está a ser redescoberta. A história curiosa do suor é desvendada por especialistas, que analisam a sua eficácia no arrefecimento e como ele nos ajuda a entender a nossa própria fisiologia. O suor é uma prova notável da evolução humana, tornando-nos distintamente únicos, e merece ser valorizado.

programme.title: Atenas: Berço da Democracia
programme.desc: O documentário explora a génese da democracia ateniense há 25 séculos, um sistema revolucionário nascido da rebelião e do derramamento de sangue, onde cidadãos derrubaram tiranos para partilhar o poder. Apesar das suas falhas, como a escravatura e a exclusão, e da sua ambição imperial que levou ao colapso perante impérios emergentes, a sua história de um século, encerrada pela conquista macedónia em 322 a.C., deixou um legado duradouro e crucial.

programme.title: As Coisas em Volta: A Vida Misteriosa dos Objectos
programme.desc: A máscara tem uma ligação íntima com o mito. De natureza mutável, desempenharam papéis totalmente diferentes variando o seu significado de acordo com a religiosidade ou cultura de quem as utilizava.

programme.title: Biosfera
programme.desc: A ilha do Porto Santo é candidata a reserva da biosfera da UNESCO, galardão que enfatiza, sobretudo a harmonia da relação entre o Homem e as suas atividades e o meio envolvente.

programme.title: Juntas
programme.desc: Duas mulheres na casa dos cinquenta. Tudo as diferencia: a sua condição social, as suas experiências de vida, as suas origens étnicas. Apesar das diferenças, vão unir forças num projeto profundamente pessoal e visceral: obter a guarda do neto, após o seu regresso de um campo de prisioneiros do Daesh.

programme.title: Jornal 2
programme.desc: O mundo em 30 minutos. No Jornal 2 analisamos factos e cruzamos opiniões. A cada dia que passa fazemos leitura do país e do mundo com dados, explicações e interpretações nas mais diversas áreas, como Política, Ciência, Economia e Cultura.

programme.title: Visita Guiada
programme.desc: Em 1130, Coimbra torna-se o centro da expansão de D. Afonso Henriques contra os muçulmanos. A carência de recursos do Condado Portucalense é colmatada por um casamento estratégico, viabilizando a conquista de Lisboa. A última campanha militar de D. Afonso Henriques, em Badajoz, marca o fim do seu reinado expansionista. Esta é a terceira etapa de uma viagem pela vida do rei, guiada pelo medievalista Luís Carlos Amaral.

programme.title: A Flauta Mágica de Mozart
programme.desc: "A Flauta Mágica", a última e mais vista ópera de Mozart, estreada em 1793, é uma alegoria rica sobre o poder unificador da música. Com toques maçónicos, narra a luta do bem contra o mal e aborda complexas relações humanas, desde o amor à amizade, com humor e fantasia. Uma nova produção portuguesa de luxo, com adaptação de Alexandre Delgado e encenação de Mónica Garnel, foi apresentada no Operafest 2023.

programme.title: O Velho e a Espada
programme.desc: Das florestas assombradas de uma aldeia portuguesa perdida, nasce uma energia maligna - a única esperança da humanidade é um trabalhador da construção civil reformado, uma garrafa de vinho, uma motocicleta Zündapp 50cc e uma espada possuída por um estranho demónio.

programme.title: Rebobinar Depois de Ver
programme.desc: Uma reflexão com linguagem despretensiosa, a análise sobre o contexto cultural e artístico de alguns filmes importantes da história mundial do Cinema.

programme.title: Cinemax
programme.desc: Cinemax é um programa dedicado ao universo da curta-metragem e à relevância deste formato na descoberta de novos talentos e valorização de autores clássicos. O Cinemax garante a exibição regular de curtas-metragens, complementada por breves entrevistas que apresentam os seus autores.

programme.title: Geração Low Cost
programme.desc: Cassandre, hospedeira de bordo numa companhia aérea low-cost em Lanzarote, vive sem amarras, preenchendo a vida com trabalho, festas e lazer despreocupado. Esta rotina hedonista serve como escape. No entanto, a crescente pressão no trabalho ameaça a sua estabilidade. Confrontada com o caos, Cassandre terá de decidir se enfrenta o passado doloroso e regressa a quem deixou para trás.

programme.title: Joia Açoriana
programme.desc: O projeto Joia Açoreana pretende valorizar os museus da região e as suas coleções. É constituído por 51 joias, inspiradas em peças emblemáticas das coleções ou nos edifícios dos 8 museus dos Açores, Ecomuseu do Corvo e Arquipélago.

programme.desc: Uma agenda cultural que destaca espectáculos de teatro, música e outros, não esquecendo o lançamento de livros e discos, o cinema e ainda a realização de outros eventos, como exposições, espectáculos ao ar livre, conferências. Texto e locução de Manuela Silva Reis.

programme.title: ScienceCast
programme.desc: O "ScienceCast - Uma Conversa com Ciência" é um podcast envolvente, apresentado pelo jornalista Vasco Matos Trigo, que satisfaz a curiosidade através do diálogo. Cada episódio une investigadores, gestores e comunicadores de diversas áreas, como ciências naturais, música, história, ciências sociais e engenharias. O programa constrói pontes entre saberes, sem fronteiras rígidas, transformando o conhecimento em conversas cativantes e acessíveis.

programme.title: UAU - Ciência Sem Limites
programme.desc: "UAU - Ciência Sem Limites" é um magazine de ciência e tecnologia produzido pela Universidade de Aveiro para dar a conhecer a investigação da Universidade de Aveiro e dos seus parceiros em áreas que tocam os Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável e os grandes desafios do nosso tempo.

programme.title: Vivam os Micróbios!
programme.desc: Este documentário aborda o acentuado aumento de alergias e asma, revelando que a causa reside na escassez de diversidade microbiana em ambientes assépticos. Através de entrevistas a investigadores, o filme destaca a importância crucial destes microrganismos para o desenvolvimento do nosso sistema imunitário, especialmente nos jovens. Propõe um regresso ao contacto com a natureza, desafiando o receio generalizado dos germes e oferecendo uma nova perspetiva sobre a saúde.

programme.title: Estátua da Liberdade - Segredos de um Ícone
programme.desc: O filme aborda a história da Estátua da Liberdade, um presente francês aos EUA e o primeiro monumento erguido por crowdfunding. Ícone de liberdade e emancipação, a sua construção estendeu-se por vinte anos. Com recurso a reconstituições virtuais 3D do ateliê de Bartholdi, esta obra cinematográfica transporta o espetador ao coração da sua edificação, desvendando os ideais democráticos que a sustentam.

programme.title: La Preside
programme.desc: Eugenia Liguori, uma diretora escolar determinada, aceita o desafio de transformar o Instituto Anna Maria Ortese numa perigosa zona de Nápoles, assolada pelo crime e abandono. Acreditando que a educação pode resgatar os jovens do analfabetismo, Eugenia percorre as ruas arriscando-se para trazer os alunos de volta, contando apenas com o apoio do professor Vittorio. Esta série, inspirada em factos verídicos, ilustra a coragem de uma mulher e o poder da escola como pilar de esperança.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: O auditório DR Koncerthuset estende a passadeira vermelha para um concerto cintilante com as mais célebres músicas dos filmes de Hollywood, interpretadas pelo Coro e Orquestra Sinfónica Nacional Dinamarquesa, e os jovens solistas Andrea Oehlenschlaeger e Diluckshan Jeyratnam.

programme.title: Folha de Sala
programme.desc: Uma agenda cultural que destaca espectáculos de teatro, música e outros, não esquecendo o lançamento de livros e discos, o cinema e ainda a realização de outros eventos, como exposições, espectáculos ao ar livre, conferências. Texto e locução de Manuela Silva Reis.

programme.title: Faça Chuva Faça Sol
programme.desc: "Faça Chuva Faça Sol" é um programa semanal que explora a agricultura e floresta portuguesas. Focando-se em inovação, sustentabilidade e novos protagonistas, ilustra a fusão de tradição e tecnologia que define o futuro rural. Com reportagens de todo o país, dos Açores à Madeira, aborda projetos e gestões agrícolas relevantes. O seu objetivo é mudar a visão sobre a agricultura nacional, destacando o seu crescimento, valor e papel crucial na economia.

programme.desc: Ambre, de 20 anos de idade, estuda Direito incentivada pelos pais, de origens modestas, que sonham vê-la tornar-se advogada. Quando um bebé chega inesperadamente tudo se desmorona.

programme.desc: Lumea mondenă îşi deschide larg uşile şi îi invită în culisele ei pe telespectatorii Prima TV. Moderatorul emisiunii este pregătit să îi descoasă pe invitaţi şi să le afle toate secretele. Exclusivităţi, momente emoţionante, discuţii între prieteni, voie bună şi relaxare!

programme.title: Elisa
Elisa di Rivombrosa
programme.desc:
Frumoasa Elisa Scalzi, dama de companie
a contesei Ristori, se îndrăgosteşte de fiul acesteia, Fabrizio. Din
păcate, diferenţa mare de rang şi de avere face imposibilă căsătoria
celor doi tineri. Intrigile familiei îi vor pune la încercare pe Elisa
şi Fabrizio, care vor trece prin nenumărate aventuri până să-şi
găsească fericirea. Dar, în cele din urmă, în ciuda diferenţelor
sociale şi a imixtiunilor celor răuvoitori, dragostea va iesi
triumfătoare.

programme.title: Sclava Isaura
A Escrava Isaura
programme.desc: Remake dupa cunoscuta serie din 1976, serialul se constituie intr-o tumultoasa istorie a vietii sclavei Isaura, o tanara de culoare alba.\n\nNascuta in 1885, la ferma comandantului Almeida din Campos, tanara Isaura este fiica frumoasei sclave Juliana si a administratorului fermei Miguel. Viata Isaurei la ferma devine din ce in ce mai dificila, cand Leoncio, fiul lui Alemida, se intoarce acasa. Acesta se indragosteste nebuneste de Isaura!

programme.title: Woman on the Run
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.title: The Bigamist
programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. When private investigator Jordan (Edmund Gwenn) uncovers the fact that Graham has another wife, Phyllis (Ida Lupino), and a small child in Los Angeles, he confesses everything. In flashback, Graham tells of the strains in his marriage with Eve and how he found himself falling for the kind-hearted waitress Phyllis while on a business trip.

programme.title: Like Water for Chocolate
programme.desc: The youngest daughter in her family, the beautiful Tita is forbidden to marry her true love, Pedro. Since tradition dictates that Tita must care for her mother, Pedro weds her older sister, Rosaura, though he still loves Tita. The situation creates much tension in the family, and Tita's powerful emotions begin to surface in fantastical ways through her cooking. As the years pass, unusual circumstances test the enduring love of Pedro and Tita.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: Family Feud
programme.desc: In this original version of iconic game show "Family Feud," actor Richard Dawson plays host to two teams, each comprised of five family members, who try to match the answers given to survey questions asked to groups of people (typically 100 people in the group). programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: Hot Bench
programme.desc: Many popular court shows are on TV. How can the genre improve? How about using a three-judge panel? That's the concept of "Hot Bench," created by Judge Judy Sheindlin. After hearing each case, the judges discuss it among themselves before rendering a verdict. The jurists are experienced civil litigator Tanya Acker, New York State Supreme Court Justice Patricia DiMango, and former criminal defense attorney Larry Bakman. The show's title comes from a term describing a court action in which a judge frequently interrupts lawyers with questions.

It also provides safety, health and training tips that are useful for different breeds of dogs as well as emphasizing responsible pet ownership and compassion for all living creatures.

programme.title: America's Black Forum
programme.desc: Political analyst Marc Morial hosts a weekly syndicated newsmagazine series featuring in-depth and engaging interviews with newsmakers, influencers, business entrepreneurs, artists, health and wellness experts and social justice leaders. Targeted to an African American audience, "America's Black Forum" was an hourlong production from 1977 to 2006. It has been revived as a 30-minute series after being off the air for 15 years, but has maintained the same format.

programme.title: Walking with Dinosaurs
programme.desc: The life of the first reptilian carnivores on Earth, told through computer animation.

programme.title: Walking with Dinosaurs
programme.desc: This programme travels 152 million years into the past to a planet dominated by mighty, long-necked sauropods - the largest animals ever to walk the earth. There were no birds, flowers or grass, and the land was carpeted by fern prairies and coniferous forests.

programme.title: Walking with Dinosaurs
programme.desc: A look at the world as it was 149 million years ago - in the late Jurassic Period. The old continents have broken up and much of the land is under water. Huge shallow seas have supported a revolution in marine life.

programme.title: Walking with Dinosaurs
programme.desc: A mind-expanding trip back through time to look at how the skies of 127 million years ago were dominated by huge flying reptiles, some as large as aeroplanes. The programme also follows the extraordinary journey of the pterosaur, which flew for thousands of miles in order to reach its breeding site. Narrated by Kenneth Branagh.

programme.title: Walking with Dinosaurs
programme.desc: This programme looks at the Cretaceous period, 106 million years ago. Volcanic activity forces the continents apart, and dinosaurs diversify into a range of species to cope with environmental extremes. The landmass that will become Australia and Antarctica is in sunlight for half of the year, and in frozen darkness for the rest.

programme.title: Walking with Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Looking at the closing chapters of the Cretaceous period, 65 million years ago, when the world is poisoned by massive volcanic activity. Among the fields of burning ash, the dinosaurs struggle for survival, oblivious to the Earth's impending collision with a giant comet.

programme.title: Deadly Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Steve is going large, as he focuses on the biggest animals to have ever walked the earth. In his dino-den, he starts by meeting the Argentinosaurus, an animal so large that even its poo was deadly. But if you thought that that was the biggest dinosaur ever, then think again.

programme.title: Deadly Dinosaurs
programme.desc: The Jurassic was home to the most vicious and violent predators the world has ever seen. To survive, herbivores had to fight back! Steve Backshall goes on a mission to track down the deadliest of all dinosaur defenders. programme.title: Truth for Life
programme.desc: In Free to Love, Dr. Mark Sandoval addresses one of the most misunderstood realities in human experience—love. Grounded in the unchanging law that nothing exists or functions from itself, this episode explains why love must be received before it can be given and why God alone is its source. Dr. Sandoval shows that love is always voluntary and that self-government is essential for love to exist. Through biblical reasoning, he explores how evil arose where freedom existed and why that same freedom must be preserved for salvation to be possible. The presentation clarifies why God never uses force, why coercion is always the mark of the enemy, and how unselfish love alone has the power to rescue those trapped in deception. By examining Scripture, the life of Christ, and practical relational dynamics, this message reveals why love tolerates evil without becoming evil and why obedience flows naturally from love rather than obligation. Viewers are invited to reconsider their understanding of love and experience the freedom that comes from receiving God’s unselfish love.

programme.title: El panel de Escuela Sabática de 3ABN
programme.desc: Explora cómo Dios comunica Su verdad mediante el proceso de revelación e inspiración en este profundo estudio bíblico. Comenzando con la experiencia del apóstol Juan en Patmos y los versículos iniciales de Apocalipsis, esta lección sigue el mensaje divino desde Dios el Padre hasta Jesucristo, por medio de un ángel, al profeta y finalmente al pueblo de Dios. Descubre cómo las Escrituras revelan diversos métodos de comunicación profética, incluyendo mensajes hablados, testimonios escritos, visiones y acciones dramáticas. Obtén una comprensión más clara de cómo Dios transmite fielmente Su Palabra por medio de mensajeros humanos escogidos para cada generación, incluso para nosotros hoy. “La revelación de Jesucristo, que Dios le dio para manifestar a sus siervos lo que debe suceder pronto; y la declaró mediante su ángel a su siervo Juan. Y Juan testifica de todo lo que vio, de la palabra de Dios y del testimonio de Jesucristo.” (Apocalipsis 1:1, 2). \.

programme.title: 3ABN Hoy En Vivo
programme.sub-title: Cómo pueden las familias enfrentar el estrés de la incertidumbre
programme.desc: En este episodio especial de 3ABN HOY EVH, John e Idalia Dinzey entrevistan a Carolann y el Dr. César De León abordan un tema crucial para nuestros tiempos: cómo las familias pueden enfrentar el estrés generado por la incertidumbre. Se analizan qué son el estrés y la ansiedad, cómo reacciona el cuerpo y la mente ante ellos, los efectos del estrés crónico en la familia, y se comparten estrategias prá cticas para afrontarlo juntos desde una perspectiva cristiana. Carolann y César De León han recorrido una jornada matrimonial marcada por los desafíos comunes de dos pecadores que aman y sirven a Dios. El Dr. César, pastor adventista ordenado y Terapeuta de Matrimonios y Familias con licencia, aporta su amplia experiencia pastoral y clínica al diálogo. Encuentre más programas sobre salud emocional, relaciones y vida espiritual en la programación de 3ABN Latino. programme.title: 3ABN Hoy En Vivo
programme.sub-title: Cómo pueden las familias enfrentar el estrés de la incertidumbre
programme.desc: En este episodio especial de 3ABN HOY EVH, John e Idalia Dinzey entrevistan a Carolann y el Dr. César De León abordan un tema crucial para nuestros tiempos: cómo las familias pueden enfrentar el estrés generado por la incertidumbre. Se analizan qué son el estrés y la ansiedad, cómo reacciona el cuerpo y la mente ante ellos, los efectos del estrés crónico en la familia, y se comparten estrategias prá cticas para afrontarlo juntos desde una perspectiva cristiana. Carolann y César De León han recorrido una jornada matrimonial marcada por los desafíos comunes de dos pecadores que aman y sirven a Dios. El Dr. César, pastor adventista ordenado y Terapeuta de Matrimonios y Familias con licencia, aporta su amplia experiencia pastoral y clínica al diálogo. Encuentre más programas sobre salud emocional, relaciones y vida espiritual en la programación de 3ABN Latino. Flash is looking for clues to the fate of his father, the eminent scientist Dr. Lawrence Gordon, previously believed to have died in a laboratory fire several years earlier. His quest, however, leads him into the clutches of Ming, the evil ruler of Mongo, and his devious daughter, Aura. Flash escapes back to Earth, vowing to foil the ruthless Ming's threat to humanity. Fortunately, in addition to Dale, Flash can count on help from Baylin, a beautiful but tough intergalactic bounty hunter, and Hans Zarkov, the eccentric former associate of Flash's father.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet
programme.desc: Philippe Cousteau Jr. is no stranger to exploration. The grandson of legendary underwater explorer Jacques Cousteau, Philippe hosts and serves as executive producer of this half-hour earth science series that examines the planet. He visits diamond and gold mines to see how gems and metals are formed, travels to active volcanoes to observe what happens inside the Earth's burning core, and checks out weather stations in mountainous areas to get an idea of how weather phenomena form in the atmosphere.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space
programme.desc: Americans have been fascinated by the cosmos for decades and rely on NASA to explore celestial bodies seen in the night sky to get a better idea of what is out there. In this series, former NASA employee Emily Calandrelli visits some of the agency's facilities, private companies and universities to speak with people knowledgeable about the topic to help "show off the coolest aspects of the space industry," to use her words. Technology, a potential manned mission to Mars and planetary tourism are some themes.

programme.title: Nature Knows Best
programme.desc: Marine biologist Danni Washington hosts this series that explains how nature has helped to inspire technology that people use on a daily basis. Some of the nature-inspired innovations include airplanes inspired by birds and helicopters that were influenced by dragonflies. The show also introduces viewers to people involved in creating innovations that are based on animals, including biologists who study the behavior of ants, architects designing "living buildings" and roboticists who are making their designs bigger and stronger based on animals.

"Hiring America" tries to make it a little easier by showcasing companies that have jobs available for current and former members of the armed forces. programme.title: Small Town Big Deal
programme.desc: To put a spin on a popular saying about Las Vegas, what happens in a small town stays in a small town. That's because small cities and towns across America often get lost in the mainstream media that focuses on major metropolitan areas like New York and Los Angeles. "Small Town Big Deal" tries to change that by telling the stories of innovation, tradition and success that are happening in rural places. Episodes cover small-town residents having an impact on others through their actions and notable businesses, including the Frankenmuth, Mich., retail store that is considered the world's largest Christmas store.

programme.title: Street Magic
programme.desc: Troy Von Scheibner first became interested in magic at the age of 12, practiced the art through various odd jobs throughout childhood and college, and now is one of the most popular magicians in England. This reality series shows what happens when the performer hits the streets of London to showcase his close-up magic and stunts for unsuspecting locals and tourists. Von Scheibner takes advantage of his surroundings by drawing inspiration from the city's landmarks while integrating them into some of his illusions, such as teleporting across Tower Bridge. Some of Troy's tricks are more restrained, though, like when he uses his talents to help passengers get off of a bus.

With the help of an unlikely friend and his parents, he soon learns that anything is possible when you have faith in yourself and the courage to take the first step.

programme.title: The Lumber Baron
programme.desc: Upon the unexpected death of his father, a man returns home to try to salvage the floundering family lumber business, find out who killed his father and save his family from financial ruin.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Nuclear testing in the South Pacific produces a giant mutated lizard that wreaks havoc upon New York City.","large":"During a nuclear test, the French government inadvertently mutates a lizard nest; years later, a giant lizard makes its way to New York City. Dr. Niko Tatopoulos, an expert on the effects of radiation on animals, is sent by the U.S. government to study the beast. When the creature, dubbed "Godzilla" by news outlets, emerges, a massive battle with the military begins. To make matters worse, Niko discovers that Godzilla has laid a nest of 200 eggs, which are ready to hatch.

programme.title: Year One
programme.desc: Two lazy primitives (Jack Black, Michael Cera) begin an epic journey through the ancient world after they are banished from their village.","large":"After Neanderthal hunter Zed (Jack Black) is exiled for eating forbidden fruit, he and his sardonic buddy Oh (Michael Cera) leave their village and begin an epic journey through history. The pals encounter biblical characters such as Cain (David Cross) and Abel, Abraham (Hank Azaria), and others, and wind up in Sodom. Along the way, Zed debunks commonly held beliefs and replaces them with his own delusions of grandeur.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: An FBI agent (Colin Hanks) must spy on his mother (Meg Ryan) after she becomes involved with a suspected art thief (Antonio Banderas).","large":"After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Quicksilver
programme.desc: A hotshot stock-exchange floor trader (Kevin Bacon) loses his shirt and becomes a bicycle messenger in a hilly city.

programme.title: Facing the Giants
programme.desc: A Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick) inspires the players on his losing team through his steadfast belief in God.","large":"Grant Taylor, a Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick), gets some very bad news. Besides his and his wife's (Shannen Fields) infertility problems, he faces the attempt of local parents to force the school to replace him. His team, the Shiloh Eagles, has never had a winning season in the six years that he has coached the boys. Following a visitor's message, Grant tries to inspire his team to use faith to conquer fear and opposing teams.

programme.title: Crazy in Alabama
programme.desc: An eccentric (Melanie Griffith) kills her abusive husband and heads to Hollywood to pursue her dreams.","large":"In 1965, eccentric Lucille Vinson murders her abusive husband, chops off his head and flees to Hollywood to pursue television fame. Back in her Alabama hometown, nephew Peejoe Bullis witnesses the killing of a young black man by racist sheriff John Doggett and is unsure whether he should testify against him. When the law catches up with Lucille, she returns home, where Peejoe is becoming increasingly involved with the civil rights movement.

programme.title: Mortal Thoughts
programme.desc: Best friends (Demi Moore, Glenne Headly) in New Jersey get in trouble after one's rotten husband (Bruce Willis) goes too far.","large":"A loathsome man ends up dead, but it's not clear who's to blame. If ever a person got what he deserved, it's James Urbanski (Bruce Willis), an abusive drunk who steals from his wife, Joyce (Glenne Headly), and promises her close friend Cynthia Kellogg (Demi Moore) that she'll be the next target of his rage. At a group outing, James bleeds to death after someone cuts his throat. But because he's such a terrible human being, police aren't sure which of his acquaintances decided to kill him.

programme.title: 7 Seconds
programme.desc: Gangsters kidnap a thief (Tamzin Outhwaite) after her partner (Wesley Snipes) mistakenly steals a highly valuable painting.

programme.title: Hard Luck
programme.desc: A former criminal (Wesley Snipes) goes on the run with a stripper (Jacquelyn Quinones) after a drug deal goes bad.

programme.title: The Art of War
programme.desc: Underground after being accused of murdering a Chinese ambassador, a security expert (Wesley Snipes) comes out of hiding when terrorists threaten the United Nations.","large":"He is both agent and weapon - a critical line of defense for the Secretary General of the United Nations. He does not even officially exist. Neil Shaw, an American agent who must uncover an international plot to bring down the United Nations on the eve of an historic summit with China. A mysterious chain of events leads to the murder of the Chinese U.N. Ambassador. When Shaw is accused of the crime, he must go underground -- in effect, vanish from his own life.

programme.title: The Replacement Killers
programme.desc: An Asian crime czar pursues a forger (Mira Sorvino) and a hired gun (Chow Yun-Fat) who failed to kill a policeman's (Michael Rooker) boy.","large":"Hired assassin John Lee (Chow Yun-Fat) is asked by Chinatown crime boss Terence Wei (Kenneth Tsang) to murder the young son of policeman Stan Zedkov (Michael Rooker). Lee has the boy in his sights, but his conscience gets the better of him, and he spares the child's life. Afraid that Wei will take revenge on his family in China, Lee seeks out expert forger Meg Coburn (Mira Sorvino) to obtain the passport he needs to get out of the country, but a band of replacement killers is soon on his trail.

programme.title: Half Past Dead
programme.desc: An undercover FBI agent (Steven Seagal) battles a criminal mastermind (Morris Chestnut) and his team of mercenaries after they break into the new high-tech prison on Alcatraz.","large":"Criminal mastermind Donny/49er One (Morris Chestnut) has set in motion a plan to infiltrate a high-tech prison in order to persuade a death row inmate to reveal the whereabouts of $200 million worth of gold. Undercover FBI agent Sascha (Steven Seagal) must stop him before it's too late.

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: An Army sergeant (James Belushi), his crew (Mark Lee, Paul Empson) and stragglers try to hold off a Nazi battalion at a Libyan waterhole.

programme.title: Fugitive Nights: Danger in the Desert
programme.desc: A Palm Springs private eye (Teri Garr) wants two policemen (Sam Elliott, Thomas Haden Church) to help her catch a fugitive.

programme.title: Finding Graceland
programme.desc: A man (Johnathon Schaech) meets a Marilyn Monroe impersonator (Bridget Fonda) while traveling with an aging hitchhiker (Harvey Keitel) who thinks he is Elvis.","large":"En route to Memphis, Tenn., on a solemn solo road trip, widower Byron Gruman picks up a disarming hitchhiker who claims to be the late, great Elvis Presley. As Gruman opens up about the loss of his wife, Beatrice, in a tragic car accident, his bizarre passenger becomes a surprisingly powerful source of wisdom and comfort. The duo even picks up a Marilyn Monroe impersonator, Ashley, during the surreal pilgrimage to Graceland.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: An anonymous loser (Dustin Hoffman) sees another man (Andy Garcia) get credit for his rescue of a TV newswoman (Geena Davis) and others from a plane crash.","large":"Serial swindler Bernie Laplante (Dustin Hoffman) makes the first selfless gesture of his life when he helps save injured passengers from a roadside plane crash and then vanishes into the night. Hoping to find the hero who pulled her out of the wreck, reporter Gale Gayley (Geena Davis) announces a $1 million prize for stepping forward. But when handsome vagrant John Bubber (Andy Garcia) takes credit, Bernie struggles to expose him amid a media circus and countless adoring fans.

programme.title: A Fine Mess
programme.desc: Two small-timers (Ted Danson, Howie Mandel) win a fixed horse race, buy an antique piano and run from gangsters.","large":"While at the racetrack, actor Spence (Ted Danson) overhears two mobsters plotting to fix a race by injecting a horse with steroids. When Spence and his friend Dennis (Howie Mandel) try to bet on the juiced horse, mob boss Tony Pazzo (Paul Sorvino) orders his goons to silence the duo forever. To make matters worse, Spence starts having an affair with Pazzo's wife, Claudia (Maria Conchita Alonso), and the police begin investigating recent events at the racetrack.

programme.title: Darkness Falls
programme.desc: The spirit of a woman who was lynched more than 150 years earlier haunts residents (Emma Caulfield, Lee Cormie) of a New England town.","large":"In Maine, the residents of Darkness Falls are all aware of the legend of Matilda Dixon, an old woman who was tragically murdered by a mob in the 1800s because the townspeople thought she was killing children. Now Darkness Falls has to contend with Matilda's supernatural wrath. Childhood friends Kyle (Chaney Kley) and Caitlin (Emma Caulfield) return home to uncover the truth behind the legend after Caitlin's little brother (Lee Cormie) has recurring nightmares about Matilda.

programme.title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
programme.desc: A scientific expedition sets out for Borneo to seek a flower called the Blood Orchid, which could grant longer life. Meanwhile, they run afoul of snakes and each other.","large":"Bill Johnson leads a group of scientists into the jungles of Borneo. They are searching for the mythical black orchid, which can supposedly grant eternal life. Unfortunately, massive anacondas have been feeding on the orchids for years. When their boat goes over a waterfall, the scientists land right in the middle of the snakes' home.

programme.title: Red Water
programme.desc: A shark terrorizes a divorced couple (Lou Diamond Phillips, Kristy Swanson) and three boat hijackers on a Louisiana river.","large":"Former oil rig worker John Sanders (Lou Diamond Phillips) became a Louisiana fishing captain after a tragic accident ended his career. In need of money, he agrees to help his ex-wife, Kelli (Kristy Swanson), whose company is having trouble extracting oil upriver. Meanwhile, thugs working for a Jamaican gangster head to the same bayou searching for $3 million buried underwater. Both the scientists and the criminals are menaced by a man-eating shark that can survive in fresh water.

programme.title: Lake Placid 2
programme.desc: Man-eating crocodiles return to the lake, as two males and one aggressive female crocodile protecting their nest, wreak havoc on the locals.

programme.desc: A police officer, the self-proclaimed watchdog of his neighborhood, becomes increasingly hostile toward the interracial couple next door.","large":"An uptight cop (Samuel L. Jackson), the self-appointed watchdog of his neighborhood, strongly disapproves of the interracial newlyweds (Patrick Wilson, Kerry Washington) who just moved in next door. He becomes increasingly hostile toward the innocent pair, going to great lengths to force them out of their home. The situation changes when the young couple decide to fight back.

programme.desc: A two-bit criminal (Sean Penn) meets an attractive woman (Jennifer Lopez) and her spouse (Nick Nolte), each of whom wants him to murder the other.

programme.title: The Deep
programme.desc: New Yorkers (Jacqueline Bisset, Nick Nolte) go scuba diving in Bermuda and find morphine from World War II on top of a Spanish galleon.","large":"Undersea adventure about a couple who become involved in a dangerous conflict with treasure hunters when they discover a deadly shipwreck in Bermudan waters. When they realize that the cache includes morphine, the pair enlist the help of an old treasure hunter to escape the drug dealers who hid their product amidst the sunken wreck.

programme.title: The Fog
programme.desc: Residents (Tom Welling, Maggie Grace, Selma Blair) of a seaside community fall prey to malevolent entities hidden within the thick mist around their homes.","large":"The prosperous town of Antonio Bay, Ore., is born in blood, as the town's founders get their money by murdering a colony of lepers. But the truth of what they did is concealed from subsequent generations. More than 100 years later, Elizabeth Williams (Maggie Grace), whose family lives in Antonio Bay, returns just as a statue in tribute to the founders is to be unveiled. When a mysterious fog rolls in, Elizabeth and her boyfriend (Tom Welling) soon discover it has vengeful supernatural powers.

programme.title: The Cave
programme.desc: Deadly monsters hunt members (Cole Hauser, Morris Chestnut, Eddie Cibrian) of an exploration team within a vast network of caverns beneath the Carpathian Mountains.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: A factory worker (Colin Farrell) becomes a hunted man after a procedure goes awry that would convert his dreams of life as a spy into real memories.","large":"In need of a vacation from his ordinary life, factory worker Douglas Quaid visits Rekall, a company that can turn dreams into real memories. Thinking that memories of life as a superspy are just the ticket, Quaid undergoes the procedure -- but it goes horribly wrong. Suddenly, Quaid is a hunted man. He teams up with a rebel fighter on a search to find the head of the underground resistance and take down the leader of the free world.

programme.title: The Stepfather
programme.desc: A young man (Penn Badgley) becomes increasingly suspicious that his mother's new lover (Dylan Walsh) is concealing an evil side.","large":"When Michael Harding (Penn Badgley) returns home from military school, he discovers that his mother (Sela Ward) has a new man, named David (Dylan Walsh), in her life. Though David makes Michael's mother very happy, Michael cannot seem to shake feelings of distrust. He becomes increasingly suspicious of the man and wonders if the pleasant exterior hides a sinister side.

programme.title: Flatliners
programme.desc: Five medical students trigger near-death experiences to gain insight into the mystery of what lies beyond the confines of life. As their experiments become more perilous, each must face the paranormal consequences of journeying to the other side.","large":"Five medical students embark on a daring and dangerous experiment to gain insight into the mystery of what lies beyond the confines of life. The bold adventure begins when they trigger near-death experiences by stopping their hearts for short periods of time. As their trials become more perilous, each must confront the sins from their past while facing the paranormal consequences of journeying to the other side.

programme.title: The Exorcism of Emily Rose
programme.desc: An agnostic lawyer defends a Roman Catholic priest accused of negligent homicide during the exorcism of a college student.","large":"The Rev. Moore is prosecuted for the wrongful death of a girl thought to be demonically possessed, because he administered the church-sanctioned exorcism that ultimately killed her. Prosecuting attorney Ethan Thomas contends that the young woman, Emily, suffered from schizophrenia and should have been medically diagnosed. Meanwhile, defense lawyer Erin Bruner argues that Emily's condition cannot be explained by science alone.

programme.title: 711 Ocean Drive
programme.desc: Mal Granger (Edmond O'Brien) is a telephone repairman with a passion for horse betting. He puts his electronics expertise to work assisting gangster Vince Walters (Barry Kelly) in expanding his illegal racing wire, and, when Walters is murdered, Granger takes over the operation. However, Granger's growing success is soon threatened by both Larry Mason (Donald Porter), an East Coast mobster who wants in on the action, and Lieutenant Pete Wright (Howard St. John), who's after Granger for murder.

programme.title: There's Something About a Soldier
programme.desc: Wally Williams (Tom Neal) and Frank Molloy (Bruce Bennett) are friends at an officers' school. Tension builds between them when they befriend Carol Harkness (Evelyn Keyes), a secretary at the school. While both men vie for Carol's affections, Wally alienates himself from the rest of the squad with his brashness. He has a change of heart when Carol tells him about Frank's heroic military service. He alters his behavior and wins Carol's heart in the process.

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: Spurred by love for the beautiful Lady Linet (Patricia Medina), humble sword-maker John (Alan Ladd) begins training to become a knight. When a raid on the castle leads to the death of Linet's mother and the incapacitation of her father, the earl of Yeonil (Harry Andrews), John's chase after the evildoers is misunderstood as cowardly running away. Transforming himself into the mysterious Black Knight, John infiltrates the castle of King Arthur (Anthony Bushell) to unmask the ne'er-do-wells.

programme.title: Ten Cents a Dance
programme.desc: Barbara O'Neill (Barbara Stanwyck) is a poor dance hall girl who catches the eye of the wealthy Bradley Carlton (Ricardo Cortez). However, Barbara has feelings for her neighbor Eddie Miller (Monroe Owsley). After Eddie proposes to her, she says yes, and even secures a job for him from Bradley. Soon, though, Eddie has racked up deep gambling debts and even been unfaithful. Barbara continues to support him, but after he lashes out in jealousy she thinks maybe she should have chosen Bradley.

programme.title: The Last Hurrah
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Edwin O'Connor, this political drama focuses on Frank Skeffington (Spencer Tracy), an aging mayor who is embarking on his final campaign for reelection. Aided by his nephew, Adam Caulfield (Jeffrey Hunter), and savvy strategist John Gorman (Pat O'Brien), Skeffington faces considerable challenges as the political landscape that he knows slowly crumbles away, but, undaunted, he remains determined to stay in the game a bit longer.

programme.title: Gidget
programme.desc: Diminutive teenager Francie Lawrence (Sandra Dee) has a bunch of boy-crazy friends, but she couldn't care less about boys. That is, until she goes to the beach one day and meets surfer Jeffrey Moondoggie Matthews (James Darren) and his friends, including Burt The Big Kahuna Vail (Cliff Robertson). Now, Francie, whom the boys call Gidget -- short for girl midget -- wants to learn how to surf, so she buys a used board and dives into the sunny world of Southern California surfing fever.

programme.title: The Fuller Brush Man
programme.desc: Clumsy sanitation worker Red Jones (Red Skelton) is fired from his street-cleaning job shortly after his girlfriend, Ann Elliot (Janet Blair), refuses his marriage proposal until he betters himself. While training to become a door-to-door salesman, he accidentally stumbles into a murder investigation when the corrupt sanitation commissioner (Nicholas Joy) who had fired him is killed. When the murder weapon is found to be one of the brushes Red sells, he must fight to prove his innocence.

programme.title: How to Save a Marriage and Ruin Your Life
programme.desc: David Sloane (Dean Martin) suspects that his married friend, Harry (Eli Wallach), may be fooling around on his wife, so he intends to steal his mistress away from him. David assumes Harry is going after his secretary, Carol (Stella Stevens), and he quickly charms her into a relationship. Problem solved, David thinks, until he discovers that he assumed wrong and that Harry has actually been having an affair with his beautiful neighbor, Muriel (Anne Jackson).

programme.title: Mr. Deeds Goes to Town
programme.desc: Longfellow Deeds (Gary Cooper), a resident of small-town Vermont, leads a simple life until he inherits a vast fortune from a late uncle. Soon, unscrupulous lawyer John Cedar (Douglas Dumbrille) brings Deeds to New York City, where the unassuming heir is the object of much media attention. When wily reporter Babe Bennett (Jean Arthur) gains the trust and affection of Deeds, she uses her position to publish condescending articles about him -- but are her feelings for him really that shallow?

programme.title: Love Has Many Faces
programme.desc: Wealthy Kit Jordon (Lana Turner) and her dissolute husband, Pete (Cliff Robertson), are in Acapulco, Mexico, when a corpse washes onto the beach. programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Successful Pastors
programme.sub-title: Pr Trustmore Parangeta - President North Zimbabwe Conference
programme.desc: Successful Pastors is intended to highlight the stories of outstanding Seventh-day Adventist leaders around the world. Each episode is a window into the lives and ministries of pastors who, by God's grace, have impacted communities, strengthened churches and brought hope to thousands. Sharing their testimonies and methods of evangelism in different geographical and political contexts, this series is intented to display God's mighty power in bringing souls to the feet of Christ.

programme.title: Living Well
programme.sub-title: Collard Greens On Baked Potato - Marcie Hornis
programme.desc: "So whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God." (1 Corinthians 10:31) How can we use food to glorify God? When we honor our bodies by fueling them with the natural God-given foods presented in the Bible, we feel capable to carry out the mission God has for our lives. This series, featuring many educated hosts, presents step-by-step demonstrations for delicious vegetarian/vegan recipes that will help you enjoy your food and live well!

programme.title: Divine Design
programme.desc: From expectant parents and grandparents to health and childbirth educators, or anyone who questions creation in this modern evolution-driven world, these Christ-centered episodes by Patti Barnes will lead you to give glory to our Creator as they demonstrate a sample of the Divine wisdom and power in human reproduction.

programme.title: Summit 2020: The Hour of His Judgement
programme.sub-title: Pastor James Rafferty - Why A Judgement Part Four
programme.desc: This Secrets Unsealed Summit discusses various matters related to the investigative pre-Advent judgment that began in 1844 and will end at the close of probation. Theological concepts with a practical tips for daily living will help us prepare to stand before the judgment bar of God.

programme.title: Come Out of Her My People
programme.desc: Satan has sought to counterfeit God’s intimate gifts with self-centered indulgences, and sadly many have fallen for the deception. One of God’s most intimate gifts, sex, was created to foster deep connection within the covenant of marriage between a man and a woman. So how can we overcome sinful desires that go against His design? Not by our own strength, but by surrendering our thoughts to Jesus and allowing the Holy Spirit to transform our hearts.

programme.title: The Prophetic Panorama
programme.desc: It seems today there are as many interpretations of Bible prophecy as there are interpreters. Is there an ironclad method for interpreting Bible prophecy? Are televangelists trustworthy in what they teach about Israel, the seventy weeks, the rapture of the church, the tribulation and the Antichrist or are they setting us up for Satan's final deception? Don't miss the answers to these and other questions in this enlightening series.

programme.title: The Book of Acts
programme.desc: In the days of the early church—before modern technology or powerful institutions—the Gospel was proclaimed with boldness and urgency across the world. What lessons can today’s remnant church draw from their example? In this compelling series, Kameron Devasher uncovers essential truths from the Apostolic church that will both inspire and challenge remnant believers to share the Three Angels’ Messages with conviction and determination, using every means available.

programme.title: Mission Revival - Outpost Centers International
programme.desc: Hosted by Steve Dickman and Michelle Song, this series brings to light the desperate need for outreach in all areas of the world. While Seventh-day Adventism has made it's mark, there are still areas of the world that have yet to be touched. This series will provide you with helpful ministry tips and inspiring testimonies of those who have answered the call to outreach ministry. "And the Good News about the Kingdom will be preached throughout the whole world, so that all nations will hear it; and then the end will come.." (Matthew 24:14).

programme.sub-title: Keys to Mistery of Life & Death
programme.desc: On the surface the book of Genesis appears to be a mere collection of ancient stories. But don't be fooled! Beneath the external simplicity lies a secret code which, when broken, reveals in no uncertain terms what will happen in the future. This series reveals the intimate connection between the first book of the Bible, Genesis, and the last book, Revelation. Don't miss this life changing experience!

programme.desc: Revelation 7:1-3 describes four mighty angels standing on the four corners of the earth holding back four fierce winds from devastating planet Earth. Their grip is loosening. Even now, the winds are starting to blow. Discover more about these winds and how to find protection in the coming storm.

programme.title: Equipping The Saints
programme.desc: The church was never intended to be merely a social club for members but a training school for missionaries. This eye-opening series presented by Kameron Devasher will reveal God's original design for His people to be personally active in giving the gospel to the world, winning souls for His kingdom, and hastening the return of Jesus.

programme.title: SUMtv Sabbath School Hour
programme.desc: Our weekly Sabbath School Hour is deisgned to help you strengthen your understanding of God's word as we go through the quarterly Sabbath School Lessons together.

programme.sub-title: A Layered Approach to Daniel 2 and 7 and Revelation 12, 13 and 17 - Stephen Bohr
programme.desc: The Secrets Unsealed Summit is an anual spiritually-enriching experience where Pastor Bohr and guest speakers address cutting-edge subjects through practical bible studies. Watch and be blessed!

programme.title: How to Find Mr & Mrs Right - Zivadinovic
programme.desc: Marriage is a life-long commitment - playing a big role in our experience on earth. Therefore in a season of courtship we must be very wise. How do we know who "Mr/Mrs Right" is? In this five-part series host Dojcin Zivadinovic will lay out what he considers "The 7 steps to Godly marriage", which covers the topics of: Spiritual Prepartion, Noticing,Observation and Consultation, Invitation and Courtship, Engagement and Marriage.

programme.title: Adverum Productions - Journeys
programme.sub-title: Dan's Journey: Finding The Meaning of Life
programme.desc: Having landed his dream job at a blue chip company, Dan thought he had it all: interesting hobbies, friends, popularity and money. He had attained what he thought would make him happy, but he was not fulfilled. Was this the meaning of life? His atheist worldview starts to feel less stable after encountering several Christians and some intriguing new ideas. He eventually has to make some tough decisions regarding his career, but ends up finding the purpose for his life in the most unexpected place. Follow this remarkable journey from unbelief to fervent faith.

programme.title: I'd Like to Know
programme.desc: Secrets Unsealed weekly Question and Answer program that dives into the Scriptures to provide clear, biblically-based answers to your submitted questions, offering spiritual guidance and practical wisdom that align with the teachings of the Adventist Church. Send us YOUR questions at tv@sumtv. org and your question may be featured in an upcoming episode!

programme.title: Last Generation Theology
programme.desc: What is Last Generation Theology? Very likely you've heard this phrase in the church during the past few years. Is it an anti-gospel, legalistic heresy, as some have alleged? Or is it the Bible-based rationale for the existence, message, and mission of the Seventh-day Adventist movement? The purpose of this symposium is to take these questions to the Bible and the writings of the Spirit of Prophecy to discover God's answers.

programme.title: Preach The Word
programme.desc: What is the appropriate biblical response to God in our worship services? Are there practices, such as applause, that should be left out of the holy sanctuary of God (church)? Let us dive into the Bible with Pastor Stephen Bohr to find out!

programme.title: Anchor 2018: The End-Time Dimensions of the Parables
programme.desc: Anchor is a seminary-level course study on the fundamentals of Seventh-day Adventist theology, taught by Pastor Stephen Bohr. The mission of ANCHOR is to settle students into the Truth both intellectually and spiritually and to provide the theological skills to share their new found hope and knowledge with others.

programme.title: The Great Cosmic Controversy
programme.desc: Seventh-day Adventists often refer to the “doctrine” of the sanctuary. But the sanctuary is much more than a mere doctrine of the church. It is actually the World View that unites all the Bible doctrines into a beautiful mosaic of truth. In this series Pastor Bohr links the sanctuary with the overarching concept of the great conflict between good and evil and explains how Jesus, step by step, resolves the universal problem of evil. If you want to know how evil began, why it continues and how it will end this is the series for you.

programme.title: His Way Is in the Sanctuary
programme.desc: One writer once stated: “The correct understanding of the ministration in the heavenly sanctuary is the foundation of our faith. ” (EV 221). But why is this so? What makes the doctrine of the sanctuary so important?In this series, Pastor Bohr explains how the many doctrines of the Bible, such as the divine/human nature of Christ, the salvation of sinful man, the Sabbath, the ten commandments, the state of the dead, the judgment, tithing, healthful living, the work of angels, and even end-time events, are explained in the sanctuary service. With simplicity and clarity he shows how the sanctuary is the great magnet which draws together all the doctrines of the Bible into a unified system of truth. Definitely a must-see!

programme.title: The Mystery Revealed - Eric Wilson
programme.sub-title: Two Trees - Spiritualism and the Poison of Serpents
programme.desc: Many Christians today, even in our own churches, are struggling with doubt, sin, and a longing to be free. But God has promised freedom through His Son, Jesus. Join us as we study God’s Word together and learn how to believe for true salvation, freedom, healing, and restoration by claiming His promises through faith.

Forced to go on the run, Blaney attempts to take refuge with his best friend, fruit merchant Bob Rusk (Barry Foster) ; however, Rusk may, in fact, be the necktie murderer himself.
